shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规主图立住蓬蓬裙轮廓
一秒传达舒适透气的核心卖点，承接点击
代入日常穿搭场景，低角度放大裙摆蓬松层次
用肩带、蕾丝边、蝴蝶结、下摆四处微距证明工艺
放大褶皱缎面衬里与蕾丝边缘，证明亲肤做工
一次展示多配色，让买家直接选定色号
用留空的尺寸标注与尺码表位消除买错码疑虑
以留空徽章与证书占位降风险，待真实资质后期合成
以主推色与留空按钮位收口促单

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for the packshot, blush pink #F9EDEF and cream beige #FAF5EC for info and scene screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and empty outline badge frames only, single rose accent
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, warm 5500K window light in scene shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet premium childrenswear princess visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, blush pink #F9EDEF, cream beige #FAF5EC, charcoal text #33383D and one rose-pink accent #E8A3B8; bright soft high-key studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with empty outline badge frames; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable hero garment angle and scale with the tiered ruffle silhouette kept puffed; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 and straight-on hero angles, consistent garment scale, tiered ruffle silhouette always kept puffed
style.surfaceSystem: light wood floor #E9DFCE and matte cream board #F5F0E6
style.typography: modern rounded sans-serif, minimal rendered copy
